topic: Position words: locating shapes in a scene

problems.desc: The student completes the sentence with a position word: the hexagon is BELOW (or under, or beneath) the circle. Accept any of those words.

Part (b): the student describes where the tilted square is using two position words --- for example, 'on the bottom shelf, to the right of the small circle' or 'below the square, next to the small circle'. Accept any accurate two-word description.
